msgs.pub:
Margin feels like wings when the rally is running.

In Ovid, Daedalus builds wings of feathers and wax so he and his son can escape.

He warns the boy to stay away from the sun.

Icarus feels the lift, forgets the warning, and climbs.

The wax softens slowly. Then all at once.

That is how margin calls arrive.

Borrowed money works for a while, and the climb feels great.

Mooners on margin never see the wax go. They only feel the fall.

I only fly at a height I could glide down from.

Marcus Aurelius began each day with a warning to himself.

Expect the stop-run, and it becomes just another price.

Seneca was one of the richest men in Rome.

He told a friend to set aside a few days to eat plain food and wear rough clothes, and to look straight at the thing he feared.

Most investors never do the drill.

They size in the calm and meet the drawdown for the first time live.

A test on paper will never feel like the real thing.

It still tells you a lot. Mark every position down by a third and stare at the number for a full minute.

If your stomach turns, your size is wrong today.

Rehearse the poverty before the market makes you live it.

Picture someone after the close, the house quiet, a pencil in hand and an overnight gap on the screen.

An hour ago, on the phone with their broker, they sounded calm.

Now they do the math line by line.

The margin call. What this drop does to the whole year.

The further they figure, the colder the sweat.

This is where real fear lives, at a desk at midnight, long after the market shut.

Funds feel it too. They pay risk teams to do the pencil work at four in the afternoon.

Do your math before you put the trade on, while you are still calm.

Midnight math always comes out worse.

msgs.pub:
A bad thesis takes ten minutes to build.

It takes years to leave your head.

You read one thread, you like the story, and you buy.

Then the stock drops and you find a new reason to stay.

Then it drops again and you find another one.

The first reason was quick and lazy.

Every reason after it is there to protect your pride.

So I write the exit before the entry.

When the first reason breaks, I sell, and the new reasons get no vote.
